subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A public clock tells time to everyone at once.”?
options: The town learned that some old tools remain useful not because they are needed for function, but because they create common experience.
In a world full of advice, students learned that health decisions should not be made by the loudest voice on a screen.
Sometimes it is a harsh sound that reminds people of labor, discipline, and the lives behind the products a town was built on.
But it became popular because people learned that a shop does not need many choices to make a good impression.
